details: Bitcoin has demonstrated recovery, climbing back towards the $64,000 mark after a recent exploit targeting Coldcard wallets and sales of Bitcoin by MicroStrategy. The market appears to be looking past these bearish events, indicating underlying strength.
title: Bitcoin Shows Resilience After Coldcard Exploit and MicroStrategy Sales

details: BitGo, a major crypto custodian, is migrating $7.3 billion to $7.7 billion worth of Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC) infrastructure from LayerZero to Chainlink's Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP). This strategic move follows a significant exploit and is aimed at bolstering security for cross-chain transfers.
title: BitGo Migrates Billions in WBTC to Chainlink's CCIP for Enhanced Security

details: Ripple is actively pushing the full XRPL (XRP Ledger) stack, with a significant emphasis on expanding tokenized assets. This initiative aims to broaden the utility and adoption of the XRP Ledger within the broader financial landscape.
title: Ripple Advances XRPL Ecosystem with Focus on Tokenized Assets

details: Polkadot (DOT) has seen a notable surge, rising over 3% in recent hours. This positive movement is attributed to the repricing of Polkadot 2.0, coupled with new deflationary tokenomics and a technical breakout above its 200-day Simple Moving Average.
title: Polkadot (DOT) Surges on Repricing of Polkadot 2.0 and Deflationary Tokenomics
